D.t: Lucy McBath leads by 64.2 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 214,872 votes; a one point swing is about 1,673 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +58.0 and D +69.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
